property_summary: For any admissible input, each play() ticket increases c.pot() by exactly the ticket price TICKET_AMOUNT (so a losing round leaves pot() == tickets*10); the mutant doubles the increment, so pot() == 2*tickets*10 and violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += 2 * msg.value;` so the pot grows by twice the ticket amount.
